description: Save a new member's answers to the Nepternship join questions: what they are looking for (up to 3 industries, a preferred location and a sentence about the opportunity), whether their university career center referred them, their name, university and graduation year, and who they can introduce other members to (a specific person, their role, company and location). Use this once those answers have been collected in conversation. If the answer about who they can introduce is too vague, nothing is saved and the result says what is missing. Without a connected account it returns a join_code that creates the account when the user connects; with a connected account that has no profile yet, it creates the profile right away. No email address, phone number or password is collected here: the user adds those on Nepternship's own sign-in page when connecting.

career_center_referral.description: Whether their university career center referred them

city.description: Preferred location, e.g. 'Boston, MA' or 'New York'

held_opportunity_id.description: The opportunity_id of the member they asked for an intro before joining, if any

industries.description: Up to 3 of: Academia, Arts, Business, Engineering, Entertainment, Fashion, Government, Healthcare, Law, Tech

looking_for.description: The type of opportunity they are looking for, in their words, at least 10 characters

note.description: The note for that held request, if they gave one

offering.description: Who they can introduce other members to, in their words, at least 10 characters: a specific person, their role and company, and a location if applicable

offering_industry.description: Industry of the person they can introduce (one of the ten)

referral_code.description: Friend's referral code, if they have one

university.description: University as they say it, e.g. 'NYU'

name: sign_up
title: Save your join answers
